title: Issuer Ratings REST API
user_story: As a downstream system, I want a REST API to retrieve an issuer's current ratings and submit rating actions so that ratings stay in sync across systems.

acceptance_criteria.text: GET /v1/issuers/{issuerId}/ratings returns 200 with the issuer's current ratings for all agencies; each item contains agency, rating, outlook, watch, effective_date and grade.
The optional query parameter agency (MOODYS, FITCH, NORTHBRIDGE) filters the result. Any other value returns 400 with code INVALID_AGENCY.
An unknown issuerId returns 404 with code ISSUER_NOT_FOUND.
A missing or invalid bearer token returns 401. A valid token without the ratings:write scope calling POST returns 403.

POST /v1/issuers/{issuerId}/rating-actions validates the body using the R1 and R4 rules. Validation failures return 422 with the error code from those rules; success returns 201 with the created action including notch_change.
All responses are JSON (Content-Type: application/json). Error responses have the shape {"code": string, "message": string}.
